vibe: High-roller exclusive lounge, cinematic, expensive, modern casino

headings.usage: Main titles, big balances, league names. Provides the classic luxury casino aesthetic.

body_and_numbers.usage: Counters, profit/hr, UI labels, tab names. Excellent for monospace-like number legibility, giving a premium modern crypto feel.

spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-[480px] mx-auto h-[100dvh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col relative bg-[#0A0A0B]
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for a smooth, premium feel

surfaces.bottom_nav: bg-[#0A0A0B]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-white/10 pb-safe pt-2

components.bottom_navigation: Fixed at bottom, 5 tabs (Exchange, Mine, Friends, Earn, Airdrop). Active tab has gold tint and slight '-translate-y-1'.
components.mascot_tap_area: Massive circular area in center. Mascot image inside a gold ring. When Daily Cipher is active, ring glows Ruby Red. Use framer-motion for the scale down on tap.
components.progress_bar: Energy bar at bottom. Gradient from Gold to Emerald. 4px height, rounded-full.
components.upgrade_card: Vertical card. Image taking top 40%. Title, profit per hour (+1.2k), cost, and upgrade button.
components.combo_slots: 3 empty slots at the top of Mine page. '?' inside. Gold border when found.
components.league_badge: Small pill or shield shape next to balance showing 'Bronze', 'Silver', 'Gold', up to 'Diamond'.

animations.tap_feedback: scale-95 transition-transform duration-75, floating '+12' numbers moving upwards and fading out
animations.page_transition: opacity-0 to opacity-100, subtle translate-y-4 on mount

mascot.description: Man in black suit jacket and sunglasses. Use as the main tap character (Casino Boss). Apply circular mask and inner gold border.

background_texture.description: High-quality black fabric. Use as global app background with opacity 0.4 over the solid dark background to give tactile depth.

card_bg_chips.description: Poker chips. Use for upgrade cards related to Strategy/Tables.

card_bg_roulette.description: Neon/Gold vibe. Use for VIP or Specials upgrade cards.

card_bg_dice.description: Dark money/dice background. Use for standard cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first layout (max-width 480px, mx-auto). Ensure h-[100dvh] so the app feels native and doesn't scroll the body inappropriately.
Implement 5 tabs in bottom navigation: Exchange (Tap), Mine (Cards), Friends, Earn, Airdrop. Toggle between these views.
For the tap mechanism: implement framer-motion scaling on the mascot image. Add floating +X text elements on click (track coordinates).
Include Turkish/English translation switcher in the header or settings (mock the translation dictionary).
Include simulated daily combo UI (3 slots at top of Mine page) and daily cipher UI (Morse code input toggle on main screen).
Cards in the Mine section should use the bento grid or standard 2-col grid with the provided image URLs as covers.
Never use generic fonts like Inter. Use 'Outfit' for numbers/body, and 'Playfair Display' for big headings.
Ensure ALL interactive elements and key text elements have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., data-testid='tap-mascot-button', data-testid='profit-per-hour').
Apply the background_texture image with low opacity (e.g., opacity-30 or opacity-40) on the main container to break the solid dark color.
Use lucide-react for icons (coins, users, wallet, zap, pickaxe, etc.).
Keep standard Shadcn components to a minimum unless heavily customized with dark luxury borders. Build raw HTML/Tailwind for custom cards.
